summary.text: Mike Weisgram is a Republican state representative from District 24 who took office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner and chairs the House Retirement Laws Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Weisgram's career experience includes owning a business, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 12, 2021.

In the 2025-2026 session, Weisgram chairs the House Retirement Laws Committee and serves on the House Commerce and Energy Committee and the House Taxation Committee; he chaired the Commerce and Energy Committee in 2023-2024.
